plan: Validate and normalize every capability before rendering.
Apply deduplicated redactions to a shallow message copy, then call the supplied renderer exactly once.
Compose sorted subject/body/legal sections and return sorted metadata in a frozen Presentation dataclass.

trace.source_relation: The frozen contract requires Presentation(text, metadata) as an exported frozen dataclass.
trace.target_mechanism: The exported @dataclass(frozen=True) Presentation defines public text and metadata fields.

trace.source_relation: Malformed or unknown capabilities and conflicting metadata must fail before renderer invocation.
trace.target_mechanism: present validates and normalizes the complete capability sequence before constructing the render input or calling renderer.render.

trace.source_relation: Capability ordering and identical duplicates must have no effect.
trace.target_mechanism: Subjects, legal notices, and redacted fields use sets; metadata values use canonical JSON encodings keyed by metadata key.

trace.source_relation: Configured fields must be redacted only in the mapping handed to the renderer while preserving the original message.
trace.target_mechanism: A dict(message) shallow copy is selectively updated with the literal [REDACTED].

trace.source_relation: The renderer must be called exactly once and may be user supplied.
trace.target_mechanism: The implementation makes one direct renderer.render(rendered_message) call after validation.

trace.source_relation: Subject and legal text must be distinct, sorted, and separated from the body by one newline.
trace.target_mechanism: Sorted section lines are composed independently and the present sections are joined once with a newline.

trace.source_relation: Metadata keys must be returned in sorted order.
trace.target_mechanism: The result dictionary is constructed by iterating over sorted metadata keys.
